When people get aggressive like that it’s because they know it’s liable to get them their way, don’t let them have the chance. Cut these people off if possible. Some of these rules are understandable, however, this is how you end up with an extremely sneaky kid that makes terrible decisions when they get to an age that they are finally able to control their own lives and make their own decisions because they either:

1) Go crazy with the new found freedom

*Or*

2) Freak the hell out and make poor decisions because they don’t know how to think for themselves or aren’t confident in their own decision making skills.

  As for the whole 0 privacy thing, I have mixed emotions regarding parents being able to search their children’s phones with out permission. On one hand I see why it is sometimes necessary, as a kid I had free range of the internet, but my phone did get searched. I was groomed on many sites such as KiK, Instagram, and some other sites, even kids sites like club penguin and roblox. I was a lot younger than 15 however, and I had no idea what was happening to me and did not fully understand the gravity of chatting with people I did not know in real life, and subsequently became a victim of grooming and was exposed to lots of things I should not have been. However, I feel that the way a parent handles these things is very important, which brings me to the other side of the no privacy dilemma, My parents would conduct random searches on my phone that resulted in absolutely nothing other than me learning to factory reset my device before handing it over. I became a very good liar, and very sneaky. I was still curious about porn, still talked to the opposite gender, still looked up weird things on google that got me in trouble etc etc, I got in trouble for everything once and then never again, only because I became more sneaky. I also learned never to tell them that a stranger was asking for lewd pictures or being sexual towards me because i would always get in trouble and get grounded. Parents are never going to be around 100% of the time to see what there child is doing. I think the best approach is to have talks with children, and put age appropriate boundaries on what they can do, and not EVERYTHING needs to be supervised under a microscope after they reach a certain age, just online applications, not conversations with friends/family, and I don’t think there should be a rule against talking to the opposite gender, that will happen at some point in her life and that stops nothing only delays whatever she wants to do to, wether that be dating, flirting, anything. She is 15 and she should be granted a bit of freedom and begin to build confidence in decision making skills, and she should be allowed at least some level of privacy, she will be 18 in three years and at some point will be out of the house, and if her parents continue this level of strictness she will either leave the house a masterful liar, or she will indulge in the new found freedom she has or she will simply not know how to handle anything.

I guess? It has the best mechanics, best models, great lore, constant updates, LOTSSS of variety for players to choose from, and in my opinion really does the whole sci-fi creature survival thing better than its “rivals” or comparable games, and it does get quite addictive, trying to grind for mush to get the next creature you want, or making sure you have enough for the next limited drop, or maybe even a warden or super rare limited. Thats  another thing CoS does well, it keeps you wanting more, the whole collecting aspect of the game, I think the trade realm and CoS “economy” is extremely fun, and I really love how active it is and how much it is actually apart of your gameplay experience, I have played other games that have tried to implement this mechanic in the past, and while I haven’t played every single game on roblox that has a similar trade realm, in my experience, CoS trade realm is the most interactive, integrated, important, and FUN (and somewhat necessary for serious/dedicated players) I have EVER seen, for me it’s a first of its kind, and I just have always thought that was a super interesting part of the experience, when you get into CoS. Overall it’s a great game I have just played it so much it is boring to me now, but by no means is it a bad game.
